info.title: Product Library Open API
info.description: Existing MuseDAM API keys require explicit team-scoped API Key Collaborator access and fresh caller-key validation upstream. The current local role alone determines capabilities; no selectable operation allowlist remains. MuseDAM owns issuance and lifecycle; this API has no key-management or collaborator endpoints. All operations use the standard JSON envelope. The public product API provides no file-download or export operations; browser, member and share downloads and exports are unchanged. All request bodies are capped at 1048576 bytes. Errors use the shared Error envelope. No CORS/rate-limit contract, 429, bulk writes, multipart upload, webhooks or approval callbacks are provided by v1. Aborted lock conflicts return 503 write_conflict with Retry-After: 1; committed mutations whose response is unavailable return 409 mutation_response_unavailable with an explicit mutationOutcome. Send POST /api/muse/product-api with Authorization: Bearer <APIKEY>. The required service selects an operation; all business parameters are flat in the JSON body. Caller identity and team context come from the API key, not orgId or userId request fields. x-services preserves the exact response and authorization contract for each service; aggregate responses do not imply every service returns every status or representation. JSON responses use the gateway envelope {code, message, result, traceId}. Success has code "0" and message "成功"; failures use stable nonzero numeric-string codes from PRODUCT_API_ERROR_CODES, documented on Error.code. result contains the entire original response payload, including success, data, semantic code, message, requestId, pagination, details and mutationOutcome where applicable. Optional request-body traceId must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$ for log correlation; a valid value is echoed in the outer traceId and X-Trace-Id, otherwise a fallback is generated. X-Request-Id refers to result.requestId for JSON envelopes.

post.description: Use the required service field to select one of the 28 services. Send all business parameters in the JSON body, not in a URL path or query string. Optional traceId is correlation metadata, not a business field. Invalid traceId values fail validation (HTTP 422); missing or invalid values use the generated requestId as the response traceId. See x-services for per-service permissions, roles and responses.
